heading: Accepted Payment Methods
text: We accept all major credit and debit cards, including Visa, MasterCard, and American Express. We also accept local online banking, digital wallets such as bKash and Nagad, and Cash on Delivery (COD). All online card transactions are processed securely through 256-bit SSL encrypted payment gateways.

heading: Cash on Delivery Conditions
text: Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to a maximum total value of $100.00. Orders exceeding $100.00 must be prepaid using an online payment method before processing. The exact cash amount must be handed to the delivery courier upon arrival, as couriers may not carry exact change.

heading: Payment Failure and Billing
text: If your online payment fails during checkout, the order will remain in a pending state for up to 30 minutes before automatic cancellation. If your bank account was debited despite a checkout failure, the deducted amount will automatically be reversed by your bank within 24 to 48 hours.

heading: Currency and Pricing
text: All prices listed on the store website are inclusive of applicable sales taxes and displayed in USD. Your bank or card issuer may apply foreign exchange conversion fees if you pay using a card issued outside the domestic billing region.

heading: Our Genuine Product Guarantee
text: ShopEase guarantees that every product sold on our website is 100% genuine and original. All items are sourced directly from the brand owner, the manufacturer, or an authorized distributor. We never knowingly sell counterfeit, replica, imitation, or unauthorized goods. Any seller or supplier found selling fake products is permanently removed from our platform.

heading: What Counts as a Fake, Damaged, or Defective Product
text: A product is considered fake (counterfeit) if it is not made by the brand shown on the label, even if the packaging looks original. Common signs include a wrong or missing barcode, spelling mistakes on the label, a different smell, color, texture, or consistency than usual, a broken or missing seal, or a missing batch number or expiry date. A product is damaged if it arrives broken, leaking, crushed, or with torn packaging. A product is defective if it does not work as it should, for example an electronic item that does not turn on.

heading: Personal Care and Cosmetic Products
text: For personal care items such as shampoo, skincare, perfume, and cosmetics, customers can report a suspected fake product even after opening it. If the product looks, smells, or feels clearly different from the original brand product, stop using it immediately and keep the bottle or container with the remaining product. Do not throw it away, because our quality team may need it for verification. Opened personal care products cannot be returned for change of mind, only for authenticity, damage, or quality problems.

heading: How to Report a Problem (Within 7 Days)
text: You must report a fake, damaged, or defective product within 7 calendar days from the delivery date. To report, contact ShopEase customer support through the chat, share your order ID, and describe the problem. Reports made after 7 days are not covered by this guarantee, but you can still contact the brand for manufacturer warranty support where available.

heading: Proof You Need to Provide
text: To process your claim, please send clear photos or a short video showing the product from all sides, the barcode and batch number, the expiry date if any, the outer box and shipping label, and the specific problem you found. For fake product claims, a photo comparing it with an original product or the brand's official images is helpful but not required. Claims without proof cannot be processed.

heading: Verification Process (Within 48 Hours)
text: After we receive your proof, our quality assurance team reviews the claim within 48 hours. If needed, we may contact you for more details or arrange a free pickup of the product for physical inspection. You will be informed of the result through chat or email.

heading: Your Options After Verification
text: If your claim is verified, you can choose either a full refund or a free replacement of the same product. A full refund includes the product price and the original shipping fee, and is sent to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after approval. A replacement is shipped free of charge as soon as the item is in stock. If the item is out of stock, you will receive a full refund instead.

heading: Return Shipping and Fees
text: For verified fake, damaged, or defective products, you pay no return shipping fee and no restocking fee. ShopEase arranges a free pickup from your address if the item needs to be returned. Please keep the product and all original packaging until your claim is closed.

heading: What Is Not Covered
text: This guarantee does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, wrong installation, or normal wear and tear after use. It also does not cover change of mind, wrong size or color chosen by the customer, or minor packaging differences that brands sometimes make between production batches. For change-of-mind returns, please see our Return Policy.

heading: Manufacturer Warranty
text: Many electronic and branded products also come with an official manufacturer warranty, usually between 6 months and 2 years depending on the product. This warranty is provided by the brand, not by ShopEase. To claim it, keep the warranty card and the original invoice from your package, and contact the brand's authorized service center. ShopEase customer support can help you find the right service center if needed.

heading: Who Can Get a Refund
text: A refund is available in four cases: you returned an item within the return window, you cancelled an order before it was dispatched, you received a damaged or defective item, or you received a fake (counterfeit) item. You must request the refund within 14 days of receiving the item. For cancelled orders, the refund starts automatically and no request is needed.

heading: Items That Cannot Be Refunded
text: Some items cannot be refunded: digital gift cards, items marked "Final Sale" or "Clearance", and personal hygiene products (such as shampoo, cosmetics or skincare) that have been opened or used. Items returned after the 14-day window are also not eligible for a refund. These limits do not apply if the item was fake, damaged or defective when it arrived.

heading: Refunds for Fake, Damaged or Defective Items
text: If you receive a fake, damaged or defective item, you are always eligible for a full refund, even if it is a hygiene product that you have opened. Report the problem within 7 days of delivery and include clear photos of the product, the packaging and the label. In these cases we also refund the original shipping fee, and you do not pay any return shipping cost.

heading: How to Request a Refund
text: To request a refund, contact customer support through chat with your order ID and the reason for the refund. For damaged, defective or fake items, attach photos when asked. Support will confirm whether you need to send the item back and will share the return instructions. Do not send items back before support confirms, because unapproved returns may be delayed.

heading: Inspection and Approval
text: After we receive a returned item, our inspection team checks it within 2 business days. If the item meets the refund conditions, the refund is approved and you are notified by email. If the refund is rejected, we explain the reason and send the item back to you at no cost.

heading: Refund Processing Time
text: After approval, we process the refund within 7 to 10 business days. Your bank or card issuer may take an additional 3 to 5 business days to show the money on your statement. In total, most customers see their refund within 10 to 15 business days after approval.

heading: Refund Method for Card and Online Payments
text: If you paid by credit card, debit card or online wallet, the refund goes back to the same payment method you used. We cannot send the refund to a different card or account. If that card is closed or expired, contact your bank, and it will forward the money to you.

heading: Refund Method for Cash on Delivery Orders
text: If you paid by Cash on Delivery (COD), we cannot refund in physical cash. You can choose a store credit voucher, which arrives within 24 hours, or a bank transfer, which arrives within 5 to 7 business days after approval. For a bank transfer, you must provide the account holder name, bank account number and branch routing code.

heading: Partial Refunds
text: A partial refund is given when only some items in an order are returned, or when a returned item shows damage or missing parts that were not there at delivery. Support explains the exact amount and reason before the partial refund is processed.

heading: Shipping and Extra Fees in Refunds
text: Original shipping fees and gift wrapping charges are not refunded, except when the refund is caused by our mistake, such as a wrong, damaged, defective or fake item. For normal returns where you changed your mind, the customer pays the return shipping cost.

heading: Return Window
text: Customers can request a return within 14 calendar days from the delivery date shown in their order tracking. Return requests made after 14 days are not accepted, except for products that arrive damaged, defective or fake. Orders that are still pending or shipped cannot be returned; a pending order can be cancelled instead.

heading: How to Request a Return
text: To request a return, open the order in the account dashboard and choose "Request Return", or contact customer support with the order ID (for example, ord-101). The customer must give the reason for the return and, for damaged or defective items, at least one clear photo. Support reviews every return request within 1 business day and replies with an approval or a rejection reason.

heading: Items That Can Be Returned
text: Most products can be returned, including electronics, accessories, footwear, apparel and furniture. Electronics can be returned only if all parts, cables and manuals are included and the device is not damaged by the customer. Furniture must be returned unassembled or in its original assembled state, without stains or scratches.

heading: Items That Cannot Be Returned
text: Opened personal care and hygiene products, underwear, socks, gift cards and items marked "Final Sale" cannot be returned. These items can only be returned if they arrive damaged, defective, wrong or fake. Products damaged by the customer after delivery cannot be returned.

heading: Condition of Returned Items
text: Returned items must be unused, unwashed and in the same condition as when they were delivered. All original tags, seals, packaging, manuals and accessories must be included. If a returned item shows signs of use, damage caused by the customer or missing parts, the return is rejected and the item is sent back to the customer at no refund.

heading: Return Shipping Cost
text: If the item is damaged, defective, wrong or fake, return shipping is free. If the customer returns an item because they changed their mind or chose the wrong size or color, a return shipping fee of $5.00 is deducted from the refund. For furniture returned for change of mind, the return shipping fee is $20.00.

heading: Pickup and Drop-off
text: After a return is approved, the customer can choose a free courier pickup or drop the package at any FastShip point. Courier pickup happens within 2 to 3 business days after approval. The item must be packed securely, preferably in the original box, with the order ID written on the package.

heading: Inspection After Return
text: When the returned item reaches our warehouse, it is inspected within 2 business days. If the item passes inspection, the refund is started on the same day. If it fails inspection, the customer receives an email with the reason and photos.

heading: Refund After a Return
text: Refunds for returned items follow the Refund Policy. The refund is sent to the original payment method, minus any return shipping fee that applies. The customer receives a confirmation message when the refund is started.

heading: Exchanges
text: Direct exchanges are offered only when an item arrives damaged, defective or wrong; in that case, the same product is sent again at no cost, if it is in stock. For a different size, color or model, the customer must return the original item for a refund and place a new order. If the replacement product is out of stock, the customer receives a full refund instead.

heading: Damaged, Wrong or Fake Items on Arrival
text: If a product arrives damaged, defective, wrong or fake, the customer must report it within 7 days of delivery with photos. These cases always get free return shipping and the choice of a replacement or a full refund. For more details about fake or counterfeit products, see the Product Authenticity Policy.

heading: Shipping Coverage
text: ShopEase ships to all addresses within Malaysia, including East Malaysia (Sabah and Sarawak). We do not offer international shipping at this time. All orders are shipped from our main warehouse in Penang through our delivery partner, FastShip.

heading: Order Processing Time
text: Orders placed before 2:00 PM (Malaysia time) on a business day are packed and handed to the courier on the same day. Orders placed after 2:00 PM, on weekends, or on public holidays are processed on the next business day. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding Malaysian public holidays.

heading: Standard Delivery Time
text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days to major cities such as Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Johor Bahru and Ipoh. Delivery to other areas in West Malaysia takes 5 to 7 business days. Delivery to East Malaysia (Sabah and Sarawak) takes 7 to 10 business days. Delivery time is counted from the day the order is handed to the courier, not from the day the order is placed.

heading: Express Delivery Time
text: Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and is available only for major cities in West Malaysia. Express delivery can be selected at checkout and cannot be added after the order is placed. Express delivery is not available for East Malaysia.

heading: Shipping Costs
text: Standard delivery is free for orders with a total of $50.00 or more. Orders below $50.00 have a flat standard shipping fee of $4.99. Express delivery costs a flat $9.99 for any order total. Shipping fees are shown at checkout before payment.

heading: Order Tracking
text: When an order is handed to the courier, the customer receives a tracking number by email. The customer can track the order on the FastShip website or by asking the ShopEase support assistant. Tracking updates usually appear within 12 to 24 hours after the courier picks up the package. If there is no tracking update for more than 2 business days, the customer should contact support.

heading: Changing the Delivery Address
text: The delivery address can be changed only while the order status is pending, before it is handed to the courier. Once an order is shipped, the address cannot be changed by ShopEase. For shipped orders, the customer must contact the courier with the tracking number to request a change.

heading: Order On Hold Because of an Address Problem
text: If the courier marks a package as on hold because the address or postal code is invalid or incomplete, the customer must confirm the correct address within 3 business days. The customer can confirm the address by contacting ShopEase support or the courier. If the address is not confirmed within 3 business days, the package is returned to our warehouse, and the order is cancelled with a refund of the product price. The original shipping fee is not refunded in this case.

heading: Failed Delivery Attempts
text: The courier makes up to 2 delivery attempts. If no one is available to receive the package, the courier leaves a notice and the package stays at the nearest courier hub for 5 business days. If the package is not collected within 5 business days, it is returned to our warehouse and the order is cancelled with a refund of the product price, excluding shipping fees.

heading: Delayed Orders
text: An order is considered delayed if it has not arrived 2 business days after the estimated delivery date. Customers with a delayed order should contact support with their order ID, and we will open an investigation with the courier within 1 business day. Delays caused by public holidays, severe weather or courier disruptions are communicated by email when possible.

heading: Lost Packages
text: If a delayed order has no tracking update for 7 business days, it is treated as lost. For lost packages, the customer can choose a free replacement (if the product is in stock) or a full refund, including the shipping fee. The customer does not need to wait for the courier's investigation to finish to receive the replacement or refund.

heading: Damaged Packages
text: If a package arrives visibly damaged, the customer should take photos of the package and the product and report it to support within 48 hours of delivery. After review, ShopEase offers a free replacement or a full refund for damaged products. The customer does not need to pay any shipping fee to return a damaged product.
